task_description: Build a fullstack enterprise-grade web platform named 'Karya Kreatif Andalan' for car rental and electric motorcycle rental services targeting online ride-hailing drivers (GOJEK, Grab, Maxim, InDrive). Includes public website, user dashboard, admin panel, NestJS API backend, MySQL database schema, and comprehensive documentation.

verification.summary: All 5 workspace packages build successfully (turbo cached). 14 unit tests pass across 2 test suites (AuthService + BookingsService). Prisma schema validates successfully. Tests cover real business logic - password hashing, JWT token generation, booking status transitions, date validation, vehicle availability checks.
